patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layout for project showcases, often featuring a large image on one side and minimal text on the other, creating visual balance and focus.

Consistent use of a single sans-serif typeface across all text, with large, bold headings for impact and lighter-weight body text for readability. Uppercase is used sparingly for service lists and descriptive labels.

A core palette of stark black and white is dramatically contrasted with a distinctive, muted peach/pink (#dab3a0) that serves as a primary background color after initial scroll. Project pages introduce a broader, yet still muted, secondary palette.
The entire page background transitions from black to a muted peach/pink as the user scrolls down from the hero section. Content sections slide up into view with a subtle reveal effect.
Project showcases are presented as distinct, full-width blocks, each featuring a large hero image or video, a concise title, and a brief description, creating a portfolio-like flow.

technique_notes: The site employs a full-page background color transition, where the initial black background smoothly animates to a specific peach tone as the user scrolls past the hero section. This is likely achieved by changing a global CSS variable or body class based on scroll position.
The header navigation remains sticky at the top of the viewport, dynamically adapting its background color and text color to maintain contrast against the changing page background.

Content sections, including project images and text blocks, are revealed with a subtle slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a gentle sense of progression. The detected 'video-hero' tech is utilized on interior project pages, where videos play as the primary visual element.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, lighter body text and occasional uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used universally for all elements, including images, buttons, and containers, contributing to a clean and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a balanced density within content blocks, emphasizing minimalism and readability.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dramatic, full-page background color shift on scroll, which transforms the site's initial stark black and white mood to a softer, warmer peach palette. This, combined with the large, impactful typography and generous spacing, creates a sophisticated and memorable user experience that feels both minimal and luxurious.
